name: Settings & Window Layout Workflow
description: Verifies the Settings tab: refresh interval picker, window-size presets, general option toggles, and persistence across relaunch.

planSteps.description: Assert the update-speed segmented picker reflects the persisted interval
Switch the update speed to Paused (0.0s)
Assert CPU/memory/process tables stop refreshing until speed is restored
Assert the window resizes to the app minimum and no tab content is clipped
Assert the window resizes and all tabs remain usable
Assert the toggle persists to UserDefaults and the window floats above other apps
Assert no dead settings remain (Minimize on use / Hide when minimized were removed)
